caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden object that appears to be a small barrel or a tub, rendered in brown tones. The object is cylindrical with multiple wooden staves forming the sides, and three distinct, darker bands encircle its circumference to reinforce the structure. One of the bands extends up to form a looped handle at the top left. The interior of the object is shaded darker, indicating depth. The wood grain is visible on both the staves and the bands. The background is a plain off-white color, and the artist's signature, "ROSE CAMPBELL-GERKE," is written in uppercase letters near the bottom right of the image. No other objects or additional elements are present in the composition.
title: Antique Liquor Keg
